modules.module_title: Preparation of the client and the unit

pcs.pc_description: Introduce oneself to the client and communicate in a gender-neutral manner.
Seek permission and orient the client about the procedure to be carried out.
Obtain filled written consent and other documents/forms from the client as per protocol.
Wear appropriate personal protective equipment (PPE)
Maintain client privacy throughout the procedure.
Respect the client's rights and wishes relating to their sex, age, culture, privacy, beliefs, and dignity.
Maintain a conducive ambience, environment and cleanliness in the setup.
Ensure that personal articles of the individual are taken and kept secure as per organizational policies.
Take prompt appropriate action in response to any problems which occur during the preparations or inform the concerned authority.
Cross-check the availability of all required equipment to initiate the Pradhan karma process.
Keep the required resources ready for therapy.
Maintain the stock of medicines and equipment
Check and send reminders to the patients about their upcoming appointments.
Perform cancellations and re-schedule appointments as required. Update the schedules on records.
